snippet.title: Kinetic - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Kinetic is a first-person parkour game with smooth and responsive movements. It's all about optimizing trajectories, using momentum and portals to complete each level as quickly as possible.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383350/Kinetic

Music by:
https://www.bobbycole.co.uk/
